  <entry>
    <id>http://arxiv.org/abs/1706.08447v3</id>
    <title>On the selection of polynomials for the DLP quasi-polynomial time algorithm in small characteristic</title>
    <updated>2019-02-28T06:26:24Z</updated>
    <link href="https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.08447v3" rel="alternate" type="text/html"/>
    <link href="https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.08447v3" rel="related" type="application/pdf" title="pdf"/>
    <summary>In this paper we characterize the set of polynomials $f\in\mathbb F_q[X]$ satisfying the following property: there exists a positive integer $d$ such that for any positive integer $\ell$ less or equal than the degree of $f$, there exists $t_0$ in $\mathbb F_{q^d}$ such that the polynomial $f-t_0$ has an irreducible factor of degree $\ell$ over $\mathbb F_{q^d}[X]$. This result is then used to progress in the last step which is needed to remove the heuristic from one of the quasi-polynomial time algorithms for discrete logarithm problems (DLP) in small characteristic. Our characterization allows a construction of polynomials satisfying the wanted property. The method is general and can be used to tackle similar problems which involve factorization patterns of polynomials over finite fields.</summary>
